caption: The drawing depicts an ornate rectangular frame rendered in shades of black and gray on a beige background. Within the frame, there is a symmetrical design composed of curling, leafy acanthus scrolls that occupy the left and right sides. At the center of the composition, a circular medallion contains a detailed lion's face, its mane radiating outward to the edge of the circle. The curling scrolls emerge symmetrically from both sides of the central medallion, filling the rectangular border with intricate, organic shapes. The entire design is executed with shading to suggest depth and texture, and the frame has a solid, continuous outline. There is a signature or inscription in the lower right corner inside the rectangular border.
title: Window Grille
